His weekly sync with RJ Johnson (closest strategic ally, US-based) is Wednesdays at 6:00 AM CEST. He uses Superhuman with 6:00 AM reminder batches to process email before calls begin.

Fixed rituals: Saturday morning haircut at Barber Point Budaörs with Bence (8:30 AM), Monday morning CleanGo+ car wash at home (8:00 AM), early-morning email triage, and the call schedule. Weekend work rate is roughly 43% — significant for someone with an infant at home.

## Interests and Values

The defining tension in David's life is that he builds the most digital thing imaginable — an AI butler — while deliberately cultivating analog counterweights. He writes as Screenless Dad, follows Jon Haidt's anti-phone advocacy, does woodworking (Steve Ramsey), gardens with wildflower seeds and hand tools, wears Feelgrounds barefoot shoes, and eyes a reMarkable tablet. This is philosophical, not incidental.

Deeply invested in Hungarian politics: follows 444.hu obsessively, subscribes to HVG360 and Panyi Szabolcs investigative journalism. The TISZA/Magyar Péter election victory moved him to tears. This represents a deliberate recommitment to Hungary after years in the UK.

Other interests: GoPro (outdoor video), Xbox Game Pass (Forza Horizon), golf or golf club social events (BOTANIQ), antiquarian books (Hernádi Antikvárium), Australian Koala Foundation supporter, Plex media server, Suno AI music generation, and Kolping Family Resort loyalty member.
